messages.subject: Manual CV-folds
parts:
Hello

I was hoping someone could help me with an issue regarding cross-validation for PLS-DA. I wish to perform it with manual folds since I have imbalanced data. I have created two separate imaging objects (CV1, CV2), each will be used as fold for the other. My crossValidate default command looks like this:

PLS_CV <- crossValidate(CV1, .y = CV1$diagnosis,
                        .fun = "PLS", ncomp = 1:5,
                        .fold=run(CV1), .process=TRUE,
                        .processControl=list(SNR = 3,
                                             tolerance=0.5,
                                             units="mz"))

As I understand I need to change the .fold argument, but I don't know where to insert the manual fold (CV2). 

Thank you,
Andreas Abildskov

messages.author: db2a70d9b31cb1f7
messages.subject: Re: Manual CV-folds
parts:
Hi Andreas,

the .fold argument needs a factor as input that specifies the a fold for each spectrum. You would need to combine your two files CV1 and CV2 and then use combined_file in all locations, where you used CV1 now. For the .fold argument it would be run(combined_file) which means that all CV1 spectra are in one fold and all CV2 spectra in the other fold.

 Depending on your dataset you might want to use more folds to get a more appropriate classification. Instead of splitting up your data into separate datasets and later combine them to have the run() argument with the names of the separate smaller datasets you could generate a factor that contains the folds for each pixel. An example for a 9 pixel dataset could be: fold_factor <- as.factor(c("fold1", "fold1", "fold1", "fold2", "fold2", "fold2", "fold3", "fold3", "fold3"))
